recentDispatches.title: Barrier Pressure Fluctuation (0 Units Left)
recentDispatches.body: The violet rim above the outer moat flickered twice during third watch. Bailiffs reported copper tastes in well water. Without fresh pine resin before dusk, outer wards fall below safe radius.
